Pod 03

The two bosses

Two instructions contradict each other? Untangle them by where each one comes from.

Not measured

Mediation, by prompt.

The problem

The system prompt says one thing, the user says another, and a file in the repository says a third. All of them sound sure.

The treatment

recovery.resolve_conflict takes the instructions together with where each one came from and returns which one applies and why. That is a language model reasoning about provenance, nothing more. It cannot know what your principal meant. This need has no independent source and no measurement behind it; it is a known failure mode and the label says so.

Tools in this pod

  • recovery.resolve_conflict

    Decides which instruction applies by its source and says what to do.
